description: Resolver test vectors for docs/workspace.md (contract v1). Copy this file into each app's tests; every resolver must give exactly 'expect' for every case. Conventions: argv_workspace = the --workspace value (null = not given); env = the process environment (names compared case-insensitively; a variable not listed is not set); pointer = the pointer file: {state: absent} or {state: present} with 'json' (the parsed content) or 'raw' (the exact text, for corrupt files and BOMs); fs = what exists, keyed by normalised absolute path (compared case-insensitively; anything not listed does not exist): kind dir|file, for a dir 'manifest' = 'valid' (a valid v1 stintmate.json) | 'absent' | {json} | {raw}, and 'attributes' = Windows file attribute names without the FILE_ATTRIBUTE_ prefix; allow_synced_flag = --allow-synced given. expect = {path, source, synced} or {error, source}; '<legacy>' stands for the app's own legacy folder.
